    Warranty & snags

    Your 1-year warranty is given by Aakruti Projects and starts the day you take handover — est. 14 Aug 2026, running to 14 Aug 2027. Raise snags from the app or right here — Aakruti must respond within 48 hours, and NirmAI tracks every claim to closure.

    No money is held back for the warranty. Escrow pays out in full by handover, so from 14 Aug 2026 the account is empty. For the year that follows, the warranty is Aakruti Projects’ contractual obligation — escrow does not stand behind it.

    Help & support

    How can we help?

    Answers on payments, QC, deliveries and design — or a human in minutes.

    ⌘K
    WhatsApp us Fastest — chat with the support desk REPLY ~5 MIN Call 1800 120 6476 Toll-free · 8am–10pm, all days EN · HI · MR Email support@nirmai.in Best for invoices & documents REPLY < 24 HRS
    Frequently asked 6 ARTICLES · UPDATED JUL 2026
    01 When is my money released to the builder?
    Never upfront. Money enters escrow milestone by milestone, and is released only after Aakruti's QC passes, Aakruti's site engineer signs off, and you tap approve. Both of those sign-offs are the builder's own staff — your approval is the only independent one, so nothing moves until you give it. If you don't approve, the money stays put.
    QC → SE → you = release
    02 Can I cancel my furniture order?
    Yes — cancellation is free any time before dispatch, with a full refund to your original payment method in 3–5 working days. Once an item ships, cancellation closes for that item; the rest of the order can still be cancelled line by line from Orders.
    03 What does the QC check cover — and who does it?
    Each milestone has a fixed checklist with photo evidence — levels, wiring, waterproofing, finish quality, and match against your approved design. It is done by Ramesh Kulkarni, QC at Aakruti Projects, then signed off by Anil Deshpande, site engineer at Aakruti Projects. Both work for your builder, not for NirmAI — NirmAI does not inspect anything. What NirmAI does is force the evidence to exist, hold the money, and give you the last word: you see the full photo report and the checklist before you approve, and nothing is released until you do.
    Builder's QC → builder's SE → you decide
    04 How do design credits work?
    Each new room generation uses ✦1 credit — your balance is always visible in the top bar. Tweaks inside an existing design don't cost anything. On NirmAI Plus, restyles of any saved room are unlimited.
    Plus = unlimited restyles
    05 Can I use my own contractor?
    Yes. Share your build packet link with any contractor — they see drawings and the BOQ and quote line-by-line against it, so quotes stay comparable. You keep NirmAI's milestone tracking on the project either way.
    06 How do I change my delivery address?
    Go to Orders → Change address on the order card. It's free until dispatch; a new delivery window is confirmed instantly. After dispatch, message us on WhatsApp and we'll try to redirect with the courier.
